description: NEPLAN is a commercial family of network analysis tools whose parent company, as the home page read on 2026-09-26 says, is PSI Software SE, Grid and Energy Management. The electricity tool is a modular, customisable package that covers transmission, distribution, generation and industrial networks; a second tool covers gas, water, heating and cooling and integrated energy networks with planning, optimisation and simulation functions; an asset management tool supports medium and long-term budget planning, investment timing and supply reliability; and NEPLAN Anywhere monitors medium and low voltage networks from measurements and assesses requests to connect renewables or charging stations. Coverage is any utility network worldwide. Access is by commercial licence through a shop, with a free demo and a student offer; model formats and interfaces were not described on the page read. Caveats: product pages give capabilities in marketing terms, prices were not read, and results depend on the network models a utility builds. Simulation uses are power flow and hydraulic network flow studies, capacity planning of connections, district heating network design and reliability analysis for resilience planning. Related records: platform-vitec-netsim-grid-simulation is a dedicated district heating network tool, and model-pandapower is an open alternative for electrical networks.
